text:
marco_ops: RCA for this morning's routing divergence published: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2468912345-routing-divergence

lia_prod: TL;DR — small fraction of canary traffic hit mismatched model variants after the router's version pin failed during a staged deploy. ~3.4% error increase for ~12 minutes. No customer data exposure.

marco_ops: Action items and owners (short):
• eng: enforce model-version pinning in router + add unit test (cheng_eng)
• sre: add an automated rollback when pin consistency check fails during deploy (priya_sre)
• product: review customer impact & comms draft (lia_prod)
• release: harden rolling deploy checklist + gating (release-bot)

priya_sre: acked — will add alert and runbook. Proposed alert: model_pin_mismatch > 0% for 2min. ETA: tomorrow AM.

cheng_eng: will submit PR for pin-check and add a small integration test in canary harness. Target PR by EOD tomorrow.

lia_prod: drafting customer-facing note. Sharing in #comms-drafts. Please add impact numbers into the RCA doc so I can finalize wording.

release-bot: deploy pipeline check 'pin-consistency' added to staging.

marco_ops: Scheduling checkpoints: 48h quick sync and 14-day closure review. Please put ETA/PR links directly in the RCA doc under 'owners & status'.

cheng_eng: reproduction steps added to the doc under 'how to repro' plus a minimal script:
```
# quick repro
python tools/simulate_router.py --variant-mismatch 1 --traffic 1000
```

priya_sre: attaching the rollback runbook and a post-deploy audit checklist. Also adding a note to on-call playbook about immediate mitigation steps.

lia_prod: added draft comms; please do not send externally until I post final. Internal note: CS/Support triage plan in RCA.

marco_ops: thanks team. If anyone hits blockers on their items, ping me. We'll close the thread after the 48h sync unless new issues surface. :wave:
